b1-nemzetiugy-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why America?
b1-nemzetiugy-01.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks why Lajos Kossuth travelled to America in 1851.
b1-nemzetiugy-01.prompt: Tell the examiner why Kossuth travelled to America and what he worked for in exile.
cues: Say why he travelled to America
Say what he worked for in exile
b1-nemzetiugy-01.target: Kossuth azért utazott Amerikába, hogy támogatást kérjen a magyar ügynek. Az emigrációban is a magyar ügyért dolgozott.
b1-nemzetiugy-01.english: Kossuth travelled to America to ask for support for the Hungarian cause. In exile, too, he worked for the Hungarian cause.
b1-nemzetiugy-01.canDo: I can say who Kossuth was and what he did in exile.

b1-nemzetiugy-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Poet of the Nation
b1-nemzetiugy-02.scenario: On a school visit in Budapest the guide asks you, a visitor preparing for citizenship, what you know about Sándor Petőfi.
b1-nemzetiugy-02.prompt: Tell the guide how many years Petőfi lived and in which battle he disappeared.
cues: Say how many years he lived
Say in which battle he disappeared
b1-nemzetiugy-02.target: Petőfi huszonhat évet élt. 1849 nyarán a segesvári csatában tűnt el.
b1-nemzetiugy-02.english: Petőfi lived twenty-six years. In the summer of 1849 he disappeared in the Battle of Segesvár.
b1-nemzetiugy-02.canDo: I can say who Petőfi was and how long he lived.

b1-nemzetiugy-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Oath
b1-nemzetiugy-03.scenario: You are a teacher. Your students ask what the people swear in the refrain of the Nemzeti dal.
b1-nemzetiugy-03.prompt: Tell the students what the people swear in the refrain.
cues: Say what they will no longer be
b1-nemzetiugy-03.target: A Nemzeti dal refrénjében azt esküszik a nép, hogy rabok tovább nem lesznek.
b1-nemzetiugy-03.english: In the refrain of the National Song the people swear that they will be slaves no longer.
b1-nemzetiugy-03.canDo: I can say what the Nemzeti dal is and when Petőfi recited it.

b1-nemzetiugy-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Cockade
b1-nemzetiugy-04.scenario: A visitor to Budapest on 15 March asks you, at a museum, what the small ribbon on people's coats is.
b1-nemzetiugy-04.prompt: Tell the visitor what the cockade is and when people wear it.
cues: Say what the cockade is made of
b1-nemzetiugy-04.target: A kokárda piros, fehér és zöld szalagokból készült kis rozetta. Március 15-én viselik.
b1-nemzetiugy-04.english: The cockade is a small rosette made of red, white and green ribbons. People wear it on 15 March.
b1-nemzetiugy-04.canDo: I can say what the cockade and the tricolour are.

b1-nemzetiugy-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A National Holiday
b1-nemzetiugy-05.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks why 15 March is a national holiday and how people mark it.
b1-nemzetiugy-05.prompt: Tell the examiner what 15 March commemorates and two things people do that day.
b1-nemzetiugy-05.target: Március 15. 1848 forradalmának emléknapja. Ilyenkor koszorúzást tartanak, és sokan kokárdát viselnek.
b1-nemzetiugy-05.english: 15 March is the memorial day of the 1848 revolution. On that day there is wreath-laying, and many people wear a cockade.
b1-nemzetiugy-05.canDo: I can say why 15 March is a national holiday.

b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Three Sentences
b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks you to say, in three short sentences, what you know about Kossuth, Petőfi and 15 March.
b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.prompt: Tell the examiner one thing about Kossuth, one about Petőfi and one about 15 March.
b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.target: Kossuth az emigrációban is a magyar ügyért dolgozott. Petőfi írta a Nemzeti dalt. Március 15. nemzeti ünnep, és sokan kokárdát viselnek.
b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.english: In exile, too, Kossuth worked for the Hungarian cause. Petőfi wrote the National Song. 15 March is a national holiday, and many people wear a cockade.
b1-nemzetiugy-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up Kossuth, Petőfi and 15 March in three sentences.
